title: Zoning map change for 862-868 Kent Avenue, Brooklyn
summary: This application would change the zoning map to allow an M1-4/R6A district and a Special Mixed Use District (MX-4) at 862-868 Kent Avenue in Bedford-Stuyvesant, Brooklyn. Combined with a related text amendment, it would enable two new residential buildings with 74 units, 19 of them permanently income-restricted.
